# RandomInt

Returns a random integer from a range.

## Signature

```jyro
# fragment
RandomInt(min, max)
```

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `min` | number | The lowest integer that can be returned, from -2147483648 to 2147483647. A number with a fractional part, a number outside that range, null, or a value that is not a number is a runtime error. |
| `max` | number | One more than the highest integer that can be returned, so max itself is never returned; from -2147483648 to 2147483647. When it is not greater than min, the range is empty and the call is a runtime error. A number with a fractional part, a number outside that range, null, or a value that is not a number is a runtime error. |

## Returns

Number. An integer at least min and below max, every one of them equally likely. The integer is exact. Never null.

## Remarks

Returns a random value: each call can give a different result.

## Example

`RandomInt(1, 7)` returns one of 1, 2, 3, 4, 5 or 6.

Effect: non-deterministic. See [Function Effects](/docs/language/functions/function-effects).
